policy: Actual cached material preparation and full painter renders. Frozen scans, fixed windows and held-out cohorts. Scores are median regional Oklab color distances; lower is better. These are not whole-card accuracy percentages.
proposalPolicy: Frozen scan-only normalization and three fixed training printings per material/treatment. Nonfoil only. Per-component color fit, independent validation, no individual-printing color fits. RGB panel gains and constrained HSB frame transform; no histogram contrast mapping.
